mapper.sql: select s.submission_id, s.group_id, s.framework_id, s.task_id, s.deliverable_id, s.submission_name, s.submission_desc, s.submit_user_id, s.submit_dept_id, s.submit_time, s.status, s.archive_user_id, s.archive_time, s.version, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, d.deliverable_name, t.task_name, g.group_name from task_submission s inner join task_deliverable d on d.deliverable_id = s.deliverable_id and d.del_flag = '0' inner join task_info t on t.task_id = s.task_id and t.del_flag = '0' inner join biz_research_group g on g.group_id = s.group_id and g.del_flag = '0' where s.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into task_submission (group_id, framework_id, task_id, deliverable_id, submission_name, submission_desc, submit_user_id, submit_dept_id, submit_time, status, archive_user_id, archive_time, version, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values (#{groupId}, #{frameworkId}, #{taskId}, #{deliverableId}, #{submissionName}, #{submissionDesc}, #{submitUserId}, #{submitDeptId}, #{submitTime}, #{status}, #{archiveUserId}, #{archiveTime}, #{version}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), '0')
mapper.update: update task_submission set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where submission_id = #{submissionId} and status in ('0', '2') and del_flag = '0' and version = #{version}

update task_submission set status = '1', submit_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where submission_id = #{submissionId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' and version = #{version}

update task_submission set status = '1', submit_time = sysdate(), archive_user_id = null, archive_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where submission_id = #{submissionId} and status = '2' and del_flag = '0' and version = #{version}

update task_submission set status = '3', archive_user_id = #{archiveUserId}, archive_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where submission_id = #{submissionId} and status = '1' and del_flag = '0' and version = #{version}

update task_submission set status = '2', archive_user_id = null, archive_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where submission_id = #{submissionId} and status = '1' and del_flag = '0' and version = #{version}

update task_submission set status = '1', archive_user_id = null, archive_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1 where submission_id = #{submissionId} and status = '3' and del_flag = '0' and version = #{version}
